Name: Clear the Cave Entrance
Description: Speak to the warden in the Keep. Travel through the Borderlands to the entrance ravine, clear the four kobolds in Cave A, and return for your reward.

Stages.Description: Follow Keep south gate -> Borderlands trail northeast -> entrance ravine -> Cave A. Defeat the four kobolds.
Return to the warden at the Keep.
The entrance is clear and the warden has rewarded you.
